_schema.description: Candidates for both houses. Seeded from the 30 Oct 2026 research report. scripts/refresh.py adds Wikipedia names as 'announced' without changing existing rows, then applies the ABC election guide, the primary lower-house source: ABC-listed candidates become 'endorsed', and an ABC entry supersedes any other row for the same party and seat (the older row is kept with status 'superseded', never deleted). Nominations close 12 noon 9 Nov 2026; VEC-nominated rows will follow once fetch_vec_candidates() is implemented.

fields.district: id of the district in districts.json (Legislative Assembly); null for Legislative Council rows
fields.region: Legislative Council rows only: id of the region in regions.json
fields.name: Candidate name
fields.party: Party code (ALP, LIB, NAT, LNP, GRN, ONP, VS, AJP, ND, WEST, SAL, LBT, FF, LCV, SUS, DLP, SFF, IND, OTH)
fields.status: endorsed (preselected or endorsed by the party, or listed in the ABC guide) | reported (reported, not independently verified) | announced (listed on Wikipedia, added automatically) | vec_nominated | withdrawn | superseded (replaced by an ABC entry for the same party and seat)
fields.ballot_position: Assembly: integer position on the ballot paper once drawn by the VEC, else null
fields.ticket_position: Council rows only: position in the party's group as reported
fields.incumbent: Assembly: true if this is the sitting member
fields.source: abc (listed in the ABC guide) | wikipedia (added from Wikipedia) | absent for rows from the research report or entered by hand from a news report (cited in source_url)
fields.source_url: Where the row came from (the ABC district page for source abc)
fields.date_added: YYYY-MM-DD the row was added by refresh.py (Melbourne date)
fields.superseded_by: superseded rows: name of the ABC entry that replaced this one
fields.superseded_on: superseded rows: YYYY-MM-DD it was superseded
fields.updated: YYYY-MM-DD the row was last checked
fields.notes: Optional: backing (e.g. Climate 200), source conflicts or other caveats
